note.value: In any boarding action you may release the Trolls. Roll on the table below: 1=The trolls go overboard and attack the Orcs; your opponent may add the roll and add +D3 to his combat total this turn. 2-5=The trolls shamble into the fray and add +D3 to the Orc combat total this turn. 6=The trolls go berserk and wade into the enemy; the Orc player may add +D6 to his combat total this turn.
